about_the_game:
The fire given to humanity by the god was never just a flame.
It was his soul.

Centuries later, the demons uncovered this truth.
They began harvesting human souls to resurrect their dark lord, plunging the world into a curse of eternal night.

In his final act, the god dropped his last ember upon a long-dead king.
The king awoke, reborn in flame, bound to a single purpose—
to fight the curse that consumes the world.
His life now burns with the fire of souls,
and when that flame goes out, the king will truly die.

Key Features

Flame Core System
Red, blue, black, gold, and violet flames—each core changes your combat style.
Power, speed, defense, absorption, madness. Your flame defines your destiny.

Stylish Hack-and-Slash Combat
Unleash relentless combos, aerial strikes, finishers, and Overdrive modes.
Fight with rhythm, fury, and precision.

Soul Harvest and Evolution
Souls are more than experience—they are your life force and the essence of your growth.
Absorb them, and let your flame burn brighter.

A World Cursed in Darkness
Scorched ruins, sleeping temples, twisted kingdoms.
Some fear the fire. Others worship it. All are consumed by it.

The King's Journey
A dark fantasy laced with fragments of humor and tragedy.
Reclaim the flame. Reclaim the throne.
Flame On, Sire!

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: intel Core i5
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: intel Core i7
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: When the flame dies, so does the king. Reawakened by the god’s final ember, the dead king must harvest souls and cleanse a cursed world. A stylish hack-and-slash action RPG — Flame On, Sire!
supported_languages: English, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Korean
